verdict.rationale: pnpm ships its own bulk operations for monorepos. It runs tasks across workspace projects with filtering (pnpm-docs-6) and versions all workspace packages at once with `pnpm version -r` (pnpm-docs-49). A single catalog entry upgrades a dependency everywhere (pnpm-docs-7), and `pnpm audit --fix` applies overrides across the workspace (pnpm-docs-36). Community users confirm recursive/parallel commands replaced Lerna (pnpm-comm-16, pnpm-comm-9). missing for 10: detailed docs on recursive/filter command syntax and selectors, explicit evidence of bulk dependency updates across all packages via `pnpm update -r`, and coverage of parallelism and failure handling in bulk runs.
